pixel: one art pixel per screen pixel (finer than ui_battle, whose art pixels are 2x2): draw at 1x on a 1600x900 screen, @2x on a 2x screen, always with image-rendering: pixelated
method: his crop area-averaged (box) straight to the size (smoothed along his strokes first for the Kirin and the water), a light bilateral filter, nearest palette entry with no dither (hue weighed up for the fire wave), every 1- or 2-pixel area of one colour merged into its neighbours, then only what the reduction loses restated on his picture (traced on his crop; the Kirin head at 44 drawn whole by hand, as no reduction keeps its fangs readable at that size) and his sparks drawn on top (see tools/ui/ui-icons.ts)
checks: small = 8-connected areas of one colour of 1 or 2 pixels: smallSparks hold one of his sparks, embers or foam flecks, smallDrawn hold a drawn detail (fang, eye, outline, bolt, seam), smallOther are left over from the reduction; lowFreq = mean OKLab difference x100 to his box reduction after both are blurred (sigma size/30), lowFreqBoxOnPalette = the same for his box reduction put on our palette; hue = OKLab median hue in degrees (hueHis: his box reduction); thinRun = the longest straight run of one colour one pixel thick, along a row or a column [length, row or col, index]

skill_slot_steel.layer: over or under the icon, either way: the window is transparent except its 4 corner pixels (dark #1a1206, where the bracket blocks end), and the gold brackets sit on the 6-pixel border, so nothing else of the frame covers the icon.
skill_slot_steel.at2x: on a 2x screen: the frame doubled (nearest, 112x112, slices 32) and the @2x icon in its 88x88 window at 12,12
skill_slot_steel.use: His skill slot from the icon picture: dark steel bar with a lit outer edge, his thin gold line inside, antique gold corner brackets (arms 10 px with his small notched step on the inner edge halfway along, 45-degree ends; pale only on the lit outer edge, his two main gold tones for the rest, his darkest on the shadow edges) with round dark steel rivets 3 px across. The skill icon goes in the window.

skill_slot_steel_active.use: The same slot, selected or hovered: the steel bar stays, his gold line and the brackets are one step brighter, the rivets glint, and the outer line turns into a 1-pixel warm glow.
